title: MCU Prep: Thunderbolts*

rationaleAssessment: The original villains posing as heroes premise informs this owner-selected companion. Shipped copy does not assert a direct adaptation or that any selected comic uses the film's exact roster.
expansionPolicy: Preserve the five owner selections in input order. Within each collection, expand the cited contents listing in its stated order and ascending issue order within each range. This is not a verified physical table of contents or a new chronological order. Preserve missing originals at their exact expanded source positions in this ledger; publish only exactly resolved original issue IDs.
permissionBoundary: The owner chose this companion. External pages support factual bibliography only and are not credited with its selection. Only issue identities, collection contents, credits and other factual metadata are retained. No external narrative, comic image bytes or availability promises are copied.

selections.originalSelection: Thunderbolts Classic Vol. 1 (Kurt Busiek/Mark Bagley): the original premise of villains reinventing themselves as heroes; the foundational trust-no-one concept.
selections.assessment: The contents listing names Thunderbolts (1997) #1-5 and #-1, Incredible Hulk (1968) #449, Tales of the Marvel Universe #1, Spider-Man Team-Up #7 and Thunderbolts Annual '97. Preserve that listing order rather than silently moving Hulk before the named Thunderbolts range. The provider labels Hulk's series 1962 and Tales 1996; these factual identity aliases do not change the selected originals.
